description: Unit tests for LearningSessionImpl in media learning module, testing task registration, observation forwarding, controller lifetime, feature provider forwarding, observation cancellation, default target updates, and prediction distribution.

classes.name: LearningSessionImplTest
classes.description: Test fixture for LearningSessionImpl, including setup of fake controllers and feature providers, and various test cases.

classes.name: FakeLearningTaskController
classes.description: Mock implementation of LearningTaskController for testing, capturing method calls and parameters.

classes.name: FakeFeatureProvider
classes.description: Mock feature provider that sets a flag when AddFeatures is called.

methods.name: LearningSessionImplTest
methods.description: Constructor initializing test environment, session, and tasks.

methods.name: RegisteringTasksCreatesControllers
methods.description: Test that registering tasks creates controllers and associates them correctly.

methods.name: ExamplesAreForwardedToCorrectTask
methods.description: Test that observations are forwarded to the correct task controller.

methods.name: ControllerLifetimeScopedToSession
methods.description: Test that controllers remain usable after session destruction.

methods.name: FeatureProviderIsForwarded
methods.description: Test that feature providers are forwarded to controllers.

methods.name: DestroyingControllerCancelsObservations
methods.description: Test that destroying a controller cancels ongoing observations.

methods.name: DestroyingControllerCompletesObservationsWithDefaultValues
methods.description: Test that completing observations with default values works correctly.

methods.name: ChangeDefaultTargetToValue
methods.description: Test updating default target to a specific value.

methods.name: ChangeDefaultTargetToNoValue
methods.description: Test removing default target and cancelling observation.

methods.name: PredictDistribution
methods.description: Test prediction distribution callback and result forwarding.
